afterTrial.q: What happens after the free trial?
afterTrial.a: After 14 days your card is charged automatically at the rate you selected. You can cancel anytime before the trial ends and you won't be charged.

cancelAnytime.a: Yes. Cancelling keeps your plan active until the end of the current billing period, and all your data is kept if you want to reactivate later.

commission.q: Do you take a commission on bookings?
commission.a: No — Fgrapher charges a flat subscription per role, not a percentage of your bookings.

paymentMethods.q: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.a: Credit and debit cards, processed securely through Stripe, plus local Vietnamese payment methods if you enable them in your Stripe settings.

guidelines.metaDescription: Content standards for every profile and photo uploaded to Fgrapher — age requirements, image rights, moderation, and how violations are handled.
guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Apply to every profile and every photo uploaded to Fgrapher
guidelines.intro: Fgrapher stores real photos of real people, so we've set a few clear standards below to keep the platform safe and professional for everyone — photographers, models, and clients alike. Every account must comply; violations can lead to content removal, temporary suspension, or a permanent ban.

prohibited.heading: 1. Content that isn't allowed
items: Photos of anyone under 18, in any context.

Photos you don't have the right to use — under Article 32 of the 2015 Civil Code, using someone's likeness requires their consent. You must be the subject, the photographer, or have the subject's clear consent before uploading.

ageRequirement.heading: 2. Age requirement
ageRequirement.body: Every Fgrapher account — not just Model — must be 18 or older. This is required at registration, not optional.

moderation.heading: 3. Photos are moderated before going public
moderation.body: Every portfolio photo stays "Pending review" until the Fgrapher team checks and approves it. Unapproved photos are only visible to you, never on a public profile or in search results. You can still build and edit your portfolio as a draft while you wait.

violations.heading: 4. Violation process — a 3-strike suspension
violations.body: A photo our automated scan marks is moved to the front of the review queue so the moderation team looks at it first — being marked is not itself a violation, and no photo is hidden because a machine said so. Every decision is a person's: the moderation team approves or rejects the photo. If it is rejected, we contact and warn you first; a violation point is only recorded after that, and only by an administrator. At the third point, the account is automatically suspended. Serious violations (e.g. suspected involvement of someone under 18) can result in an immediate suspension and a report to authorities where the law requires it.

appeals.heading: 5. Appealing a rejected photo
appeals.body: If you believe a photo was rejected in error, message support through the Contact page with which photo and why you think the decision was wrong. Every appeal is reviewed independently by a different admin.

reporting.heading: 6. Reporting a violation
reporting.body: Every profile has a "Report" option. Reports about inappropriate content or a profile suspected of belonging to someone under 18 go into a high-priority queue and are handled as soon as possible.

guide.metaDescription: A step-by-step guide to using Fgrapher — signing up, finding and booking an artist, posting a request, identity verification, setting up a provider profile, and managing your account.
guide.title: Fgrapher user guide
guide.subtitle: Step by step, for both clients and providers
guide.intro: This page covers everything you need to use Fgrapher — from creating an account to booking, messaging, and managing your profile. Pick the section that applies to you below.

sections.heading: Create an account
steps: Choose "Khách hàng" (Client) when registering — you just need your name, email, date of birth (18+), and a password.
Client accounts are always free: searching, booking, and messaging cost nothing.

sections.heading: Find the right artist
steps: Use the search bar on the homepage or the "Tìm kiếm" (Search) page to filter by role, style, province, ward, and budget.
Sort results by top rated, price, or newest.
Check a provider's full profile: portfolio, price ranges, service area, and real reviews from past clients.

sections.heading: Book directly with an artist
steps: Open the provider's profile and click "Đặt lịch" (Book).
Pick a service package (or describe your own request if they don't have one that fits), then choose an open date and time.
Fill in your contact details, shoot location, and notes, then confirm the request.
The provider accepts or declines within 48 hours — you're notified as soon as they respond.

sections.heading: Not sure who to pick? Post a request and let providers pitch you
steps: Go to "Tạo yêu cầu" (Create request): describe what you need — role, shoot date (or a flexible range), area, budget, and reference photos if you have any.
You'll need a verified phone number before publishing a request, to cut down on fake ones.
Matching providers send you offers; review them and accept the one you like to turn it into a real booking.

sections.heading: Message an artist
steps: Chat directly through "Tin nhắn" (Messages), including image attachments.
Every booking automatically gets its own conversation thread for details.

sections.heading: Leave a review after your session
steps: Once the provider marks the booking "Hoàn thành" (Completed), you have 30 days to leave a star rating and a written review.
Your review helps other clients pick the right person.

sections.heading: Save a favorite profile
steps: Tap the save icon on any profile to find it again later on the "Đã lưu" (Saved) page.

sections.heading: Register and choose your role
steps: Choose "Nhà cung cấp" (Provider) when registering, then pick exactly one role: Photographer, Videographer, Make-up Artist, Studio, or Model.
Right now each account holds one provider role at a time.
Every role is free during this early access period — we'll give at least 30 days' notice before any charge starts.

sections.heading: Verify your identity
steps: Go to "Xác minh danh tính" (Identity verification), reachable from Settings → Roles or a shortcut right after registering.
Enter your real legal name and ID number, and upload both sides of your ID plus one selfie photo.
Your profile stays private until this step is approved — usually within a few business days.

sections.heading: Complete your profile
steps: In Settings → Profile: write your bio, pick at least one specialty category, set a price range, and choose the province/ward you serve (or turn on "serves nationwide").
Add social links if you'd like: website, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok.
Studio profiles add address, floor area, and amenities; Model profiles add height, measurements, experience level, and an option to hide your exact location.

sections.heading: Upload your portfolio
steps: Create an album (name it, pick a category), then upload photos or video.
Every photo/video needs to pass content moderation before it's shown publicly — you can still build and edit your portfolio as a draft while you wait.

sections.heading: Add services and set your schedule
steps: Create service packages with a name, duration, and price so clients can book you easily.
Set a weekly working schedule (toggle each day, start/end time) and block off any one-off dates you're unavailable.

sections.heading: Your profile goes public automatically once ready
steps: There's no "publish" button to click — once you're verified, have at least one approved photo, and have picked at least one category, your profile goes live and starts showing up in search on its own.

sections.heading: Handle booking requests
steps: New booking requests show up under "Lịch đặt" (Bookings) in your dashboard — accept or decline.
The client's phone number and exact address only appear once you accept.
After the shoot date, mark the booking "Hoàn thành" (Completed) so the client can leave a review.

sections.heading: Find opportunities from client requests
steps: Browse the public request list, or the personalized opportunities feed in your dashboard (matched to your role/area).
Send an offer with your proposed price, a date if the request allows a flexible one, and a message. You can edit or withdraw it while the client hasn't picked anyone yet.

sections.heading: Manage your reviews
steps: See every review and your overall stats under "Đánh giá" (Reviews).
You can post one response per review you receive.

sections.heading: Switch roles
steps: An unverified role can be removed and swapped for another right in Settings → Roles.
A verified role requires a "Yêu cầu đổi vai trò" (Role change request) for an admin to review — a stricter process since it involves an already-verified identity.

sections.heading: Notifications
steps: Check new notifications via the bell icon in the nav, or the full "Thông báo" (Notifications) page.
Choose email vs. in-app delivery per category under Settings → Notifications.

sections.heading: Account settings
steps: Change your email, phone number (verified via an OTP code), password, display language, and light/dark theme under Settings → Account.

sections.heading: Personal data & privacy
steps: Review what data Fgrapher stores about you under Settings → Data & Privacy.
Download a copy of your data, or submit an account deletion request — handled through the proper personal-data protection process.
